what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard school administrators describe the newly ratified teacher contract, with cost-of-living increases over three years; no budget vote was taken.
Paraprofessional, cafeteria and unaffiliated staff contracts were also reviewed, along with higher substitute pay rates.
Administrators said Lunenburg will receive an ESSER III federal entitlement spendable over three fiscal years; the ESSER II application is held to pair with it.
The Town Manager reported capital bids under or near their funding, a one-year pay-as-you-throw bag offer with an increase, and a solid waste surplus.
Procedures discussion was passed over until July, and next week's meeting is limited to approving outstanding minutes.

why_it_matters: The new school contracts set salary and wage costs for three years, which feed the school budget and the tax bill residents are asked to vote on.
The pay-as-you-throw bag contract and the school's ESSER federal funds touch household trash costs and one-time school spending that does not recur in the town budget.
